introParas: Queens weddings and Sweet Sixteens tend to draw the biggest guest lists we see all season, and a busy catering hall in Astoria, Flushing or Forest Hills already comes with a lot of visual noise — patterned carpet, mirrored columns, a dance floor lit in three different colors at once. A flower wall gives that room one calm, consistent spot, and with a large crowd it doubles as a release valve: guests who don't want to wait in the photo booth line have somewhere else to take pictures, which keeps both areas moving instead of funneling everyone through a single station all night.

We carry more than thirty handmade styles, from soft blush arrangements that suit a traditional wedding to bold tropical and monochrome walls that hold their own against a catering hall's brighter decor. The walls are freestanding and sized for standard ceiling heights, so they set up cleanly in a rented banquet room without needing anything mounted to the walls, and they travel well between the multiple halls many Queens venues run events out of on the same weekend.

Rent one alone as a backdrop for a bridal or baby shower, or set it up behind a mirror or 360 booth so every photo from a long Queens reception — cocktail hour through last dance — shares one considered look instead of whatever corner of the hall people happened to be standing in. Neon signage mounts directly on the flowers for a name, date or monogram. Delivery, setup and pickup are all handled by us, and Queens is a standard service area with no surprise fees on the final invoice.

faqs.q: Will a flower wall help with a big Queens catering hall crowd?
faqs.a: Yes, in two ways. It gives the room one calm, considered photo spot instead of a busy patterned carpet or mirrored column background, and with a large guest list it works as a second photo destination — guests who don't want to queue at the booth still have somewhere to take pictures.

faqs.q: Can a flower wall fit in a Queens catering hall that's already tight on space?
faqs.a: Almost always. Our walls are freestanding and sized for standard ceiling heights, so they fit into a corner of a banquet room without needing anything mounted to the walls. Tell us your venue and we'll confirm the exact spot before you book.

faqs.q: Can we rent a flower wall without a booth for a Queens shower or Sweet Sixteen?
faqs.a: Yes. Plenty of Queens clients rent a wall on its own as a backdrop for a shower, milestone birthday or brand event. Delivery, setup and pickup are included and quoted from your venue ZIP code.

faqs.q: Are the flowers real, and will they hold up through a long Queens reception?
faqs.a: They're high-quality artificial arrangements, which is what makes them practical for a full evening. They hold their shape and color through hours of catering hall lighting and traffic, and they aren't affected by allergies or season.

faqs.q: Do you charge a travel fee in Queens?
faqs.a: Queens is a standard service area with no surprise fees. We quote travel from your venue ZIP code before you book, so it's on the quote, not the final invoice.

faqs.q: Can we add neon signage to the flower wall for a Queens wedding or Sweet Sixteen?
faqs.a: Yes. Neon signage is available as an add-on — names, a date or a monogram mounted directly on the flowers — and it stands out well once a catering hall dims its lights for the reception.

faqs.q: Can the flower wall pair with a roaming photo booth for a large guest list?
faqs.a: Yes, and it's a common combination for Queens events with big headcounts. The wall anchors one part of the room while a roaming attendant covers the tables and cocktail hour, so coverage doesn't depend on everyone lining up in one place.

faqs.q: Do you carry insurance and can you provide a COI for our Queens venue?
faqs.a: Yes. We carry a $3 million liability insurance policy. If your venue needs a certificate of insurance naming them as additionally insured, reply to your booking confirmation with their contact details and we'll send it over.

faqs.q: Can we rent a flower wall for a backyard quinceañera or family celebration?
faqs.a: Yes. Backyard and small-venue bookings are common in Ridgewood and Jamaica, and the freestanding wall sets up outdoors the same way it does inside a catering hall — we'll just confirm ground conditions and weather protection ahead of time.

faqs.q: Does a catering hall's back-to-back event schedule affect delivery timing?
faqs.a: We coordinate delivery and setup directly with the hall's event coordinator so it lands in the window between the prior event's breakdown and your own start time — common in Astoria and Flushing halls that book multiple events on a Saturday.
